_readme: Upscaler defaults. Changes made in the web UI or with `upscale --save` are
written to config/upscale.local.json, which overrides this file and is
gitignored, so local choices survive restarts without dirtying the repo.
model: realesr-animevideov3 ships native x2/x3/x4 and suits illustration;
realesrgan-x4plus / -anime are x4 only and are downscaled for 2x and 3x.
